The Pillars of Creation lie in the const.why: Not found stated directly: 0 exact hits for three direct phrasings, against 594 for 'Pillars of Creation in the Eagle Nebula' and 42 for 'Eagle Nebula in the constellation Serpens'. Pillars and Serpens co-occur 572 times out of 14,772 mentions of the Pillars (versus 4,196 with the Eagle Nebula); the sampled hits all reach Serpens through M16, the Eagle Nebula. Wikipedia's Pillars lead also states it only through the nebula ('in the Eagle Nebula of the constellation Serpens'). Rated likely, not very_likely, because that chained phrasing is common.
